exclusion_rule: HealingMaps listings NOT tagged as a psychedelic/psychedelic-therapy category (GLP-1, peptide, generic wellness clinics the source also lists). Historical: the 2026-09-02 harvest; the source has refused us since

ClinicalTrials.gov records matching a search term but carrying NO psychedelic intervention (93 when the rule began on 2026-09-02; 0 since, because the harvester now queries only the intervention field)
enforcement: no-drug-evidence artifact drop in harvest_ctgov.py (count from its own log)

exclusion_rule: Studies whose indication is anesthesia/analgesia/procedural-sedation, sharing only a molecule (ketamine) with the therapeutic field
enforcement: relevance classifier (psychiatric/anesthesia_analgesia/other); anesthesia excluded from index

exclusion_rule: Trial-site rows belonging to anesthesia/analgesia studies above
enforcement: same classifier, propagated to site rows

exclusion_rule: Psychedelic term appears only in the abstract and the title is not clinical — a passing mention (how a COVID-19 meta-analysis and a Japan-Hungary diplomatic history entered the corpus before 2026-10-02)
enforcement: is_relevant() in scope.py; scope = psychedelic medicine

exclusion_rule: Returned by the search but no psychedelic term in title or abstract
Psychedelic is the title subject but the framing is humanities, ethnography, taxonomy or cultivation, not medicine
'Microdosing' in the title without any psychedelic named: pharmacology's phase-0 microdose (oncology, fertility, veterinary anaesthesia)
Phencyclidine (PCP) or MK-801 is the title's only drug: pharmacology's psychosis-model NMDA antagonists, in on a ketamine mention in the abstract
Non-treatment organizations (law firms, funders, regulators, advocacy groups, drug developers) reclassified out of the clinics layer — they remain in the industry layer
Duplicate operator rows collapsed (same name and country, city missing or contained)
enforcement: second-pass dedupe in merge_master.py; every merge logged to dedupe_merges.csv

exclusion_rule: One licensee listed twice (legal name and dba) folded on its state licence and website
enforcement: licence fold in merge_master.py; logged to dedupe_merges.csv

exclusion_rule: Contact values stripped as source-template leaks (e.g. an NIMH inquiry address printed on hundreds of unrelated clinic listings)
enforcement: shared-contact guard in merge_master.py; values logged to shared_contacts_stripped.csv

exclusion_rule: Rows quarantined at merge: non-facility organizations, wellness residue, unidentifiable rows
enforcement: validate.py gate; quarantine.csv with written reasons
